description: Given a company (company_url, LinkedIn's numeric linkedin_company_id as linkedin_company_info returns it, an exact company_name, or a companies.id UUID), return engagers (across your collected posts) who have a position at that company. Relation filter: 'coworker' = current employees, 'alumni' = any past or current position (most useful for page_type='SCHOOL' companies), 'any' = both. Matches need job history on file, and engagers collected from reactions/comments usually have none: `coverage` counts candidates (engagers whose headline or current company names the company) with and without job history, and when missing data may hide matches `_meta.next_step` names enrich_people with the exact person_ids to pass and its credit cost. The company must be saved in Flux: if it is not, the error's `_meta.next_step` names linkedin_company_info (1 credit) with the arguments that save it; a company_name that matches several saved companies returns `candidates` to pick from instead of guessing. Pure DB read — no LinkedIn pull, no credits charged.

company_name.description: Exact company name, case-insensitive. Several matches return candidates.

linkedin_company_id.description: LinkedIn's numeric company id (the `id` linkedin_company_info returns)

relation.description: coworker = current employees only; alumni = any position (past or current); any = both

name: get_alumni_engagers
title: Alumni / Coworker Engagers for a Company
